supersedes_diagnostic: S17 (docs/research/s17_order_block_continuation) failed development with PF 0.662 (base): 84% of trades hit a full stop because 'first touch of the zone' fired on noisy dips with no genuine reaction. This protocol changes ONLY the trigger mechanism (rejection candle required) and keeps regime/structure/flow/execution identical, to isolate that one variable — the same fix that turned S8 into S8v2 in this project's history.

hypotheses.bars: closed 15m; execution no earlier than next 1m open
hypotheses.regime: identical to S17: 4h EMA200 trend+slope confirmed by 1h ADX(14) >= 20
hypotheses.structure: identical order-block detection to S17 (displacement >=1.5x ATR within 3 bars, 3-bar peak volume >=1.2x trailing-20-bar average, confirmed 3 bars after formation, zone active up to 32 bars)
hypotheses.trigger: a zone now SURVIVES a weak touch instead of being consumed by it. On each bar the zone is entered: if price closes clean through it (long: close < bottom; short: close > top), the zone is invalidated with no trade. Otherwise, if the bar is a rejection candle (directional body: close beyond open in the trend direction, AND close position in the outer 60% of the bar's own high-low range on the correct side), the zone is consumed with exactly one attempt. A non-rejection touch leaves the zone active for a later bar.
hypotheses.flow: OBV must still be on the trend side of its own EMA(9) at the rejection bar
hypotheses.risk: stop = zone boundary opposite the trend direction, minus/plus 0.15 ATR buffer; actual-fill stop width clamped 0.50-3.00 ATR
hypotheses.exit: identical to S16/S17: breakeven-then-chandelier trailing activated at +1.0R, trail at best-price minus 1.5x ATR (ATR frozen at entry); 5.0R hard cap; 240 minute time stop

hypotheses.trigger: identical to H1, PLUS: a bullish (long) / bearish (short) RSI-price divergence pivot (scalp_strategy.divergence_events) must have fired within the rejection bar or either of the previous two bars

execution_intentionally_identical_to_s16: so any performance delta versus S17 is attributable ONLY to the rejection-candle trigger change

symbols.note: No BTC reference series is used.

promotion_gates.development_to_validation: PF >1.05, net PnL >0, at least 40 fills
promotion_gates.validation_to_retrospective_evaluation: base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, at least 20 base fills, at least 2/3 symbols net positive, no symbol >60% gross profit
promotion_gates.paper_to_live: at least 200 prospective candidates across three full frozen months, PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress, expectancy >=0.10R, 95% session-block bootstrap lower bound >0, max DD <=4%

execution.one_global_position: single global minute event loop with one shared cash balance, pending order and open position across the correlated ETH/SOL/BNB cluster
execution.ambiguous_bar: stop first; no favorable exit on limit fill minute

selection: Exactly H1 and H2 central configurations. No parameter grid over the rejection close-position threshold (fixed at 0.6, the same value already used elsewhere in this codebase's price-action trigger, e.g. gates_c.check_price_action_trigger) or any other parameter. A failing gate stops that route; choose no least-bad winner.
stress_semantics: Stress and severe are deployability replays: higher costs and limit penetration are known before entry, so the reward/cost filter is reapplied and the fill cohort may shrink.
known_limitations: Same order-block, ATR-freeze and no-order-book-reconstruction simplifications as S17.
This is a retrospective diagnostic; not a live paper-forward result.
